title: rosa spinosissima f. javalambrensis
intro: Rosa spinosissima f. javalambrensis, commonly known as Javalambrensis rose or more commonly known as the Alpine Rose, is a plant species known for its thorny stems and fragrant flowers. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa spinosissima f. javalambrensis are believed to be attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
